consolidated_case_source_lineage.note: The active consolidated line list contains the 2018-2019 and 2020-2026 dengue datasets, confirmed by the project team as CHO-verified. Earlier explicitly synthetic 2018-2019 demo copies remain separately archived and excluded.

active_case_source_verification: The project team confirms all active 2018-2026 dengue case datasets were verified by CHO. Earlier files explicitly marked synthetic remain excluded.

synthetic_supplement.source_owner_assertion: Submitted filenames explicitly identify the files as synthetic; they are not CHO-verified observations.
synthetic_supplement.synthetic_provenance_note: These are the earlier synthetic demonstration copies only. The subsequently submitted 2018-2019 CSVs are different records, attributed to CHO by the user, and are stored separately in datasets/cho_historical and included in the active consolidated source.

system_policy.included_in_project_as: separate synthetic supplement for traceability and development/demo use
system_policy.reason: Synthetic records cannot establish real case trends or model accuracy; several barangay values do not match the official Iligan list.

latest_submission_review.result: The latest submission has 1,792 rows for 2018 and 1,898 rows for 2019, and does not match the earlier synthetic copies.
latest_submission_review.decision: Latest CHO-verified files are integrated in datasets/WILBUR_DSO_dengue_2018_2026_authoritative.csv. The earlier synthetic copies remain archived and excluded.

privacy: Aggregate inventory only; no patient-level data is included.

patient_line_list.duplicate_policy: Retain and flag for CHO review; no stable case identifier is present, so demographic/location matches are not automatically removed.
patient_line_list.record_type: Individual case line list; rows with valid DAdmit and official barangay are aggregated for model input.
patient_line_list.case_definition: DAdmit and current-address barangay are present; confirmation criteria and case-definition version are not represented in the source workbook.
patient_line_list.reporting_delay: Cannot be calculated; source has admission date but no received/entered date.

monthly_model_dataset.zero_semantics: Based on the project-team confirmation of CHO data completeness for the CHO-sourced dataset, covered barangay-months with no line-list rows are treated as zero cases.
monthly_model_dataset.training_gate: Zero-versus-missing ambiguity cleared by the recorded completeness confirmation; retraining is permitted, with remaining case-definition, duplicate, and reporting-delay limitations disclosed.

weekly_feasibility_candidate.zero_policy: No-case weeks within the CHO-sourced dataset are treated as zero based on the project-team confirmation of CHO data completeness; a separate CHO zero-report register was not supplied.

weather.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API ERA5 for gap-filled rows; existing per-barangay archive values retained for other periods
weather.source_url: https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive (ERA5 gap-fill retained in local weather cache)
weather.scope: One boundary-derived representative point per official barangay; modeled grid-cell estimates, and adjacent barangays may share grid cells.

variables_and_units.humidity_pct: monthly mean of daily mean relative humidity, percent

weather.matching: One boundary-derived representative point per official barangay; modeled grid-cell estimates, and adjacent barangays may share grid cells.
weather.model_resolution_note: ERA5 reanalysis (approximately 0.25 degrees / 25 km) was requested explicitly for missing historical values because it provides all three required variables, including precipitation. ERA5-Land does not provide precipitation in this archive. Requested coordinates and API-returned grid coordinates are saved to audit shared grid cells.
weather.limitations: Open-Meteo archive values are reanalysis/model estimates and are not direct barangay station observations. Validate against PAGASA or other authorized station records before treating them as locally verified. If live retrieval fails, legacy city-point cache is retained and labeled as non-local fallback.

model_weather_compatibility.training_weather_scope: One boundary-derived representative point per official barangay; modeled grid-cell estimates, and adjacent barangays may share grid cells.
model_weather_compatibility.current_weather_scope: One boundary-derived representative point per official barangay; modeled grid-cell estimates, and adjacent barangays may share grid cells.
model_weather_compatibility.note: The saved model was retrained using the current Open-Meteo historical monthly weather at one representative point per barangay.

governance_gaps: Document CHO authorization, access roles, retention, and approved transfer/storage method for source records.
Obtain the CHO case definition/version and identify which records are confirmed versus suspected.
Capture report-received dates and maintain the completeness confirmation for future data updates.
Obtain a stable de-identified case key so true duplicate records can be resolved safely.
Validate barangay representative-point reanalysis estimates against PAGASA or another authorized station source before operational use.
modeling_decision: Monthly forecasting is enabled using the recorded completeness confirmation and the updated per-barangay weather inputs. Scores remain provisional because the source does not document the CHO case definition, report-received dates, or stable identifiers for resolving duplicate records; final test performance must beat simple baselines.

case_reporting_completeness_confirmation.source: CHO-provided dengue case line-list datasets for 2018-2019 and consolidated 2020-2026 source
case_reporting_completeness_confirmation.confirmed_by: Project team confirmation that active dengue datasets are CHO-verified and complete for covered months
case_reporting_completeness_confirmation.confirmation_method: Project team confirmation in this conversation on 2026-10-19.
case_reporting_completeness_confirmation.geographic_scope: 44 official Iligan City barangays represented in the monthly modeling grid
case_reporting_completeness_confirmation.zero_interpretation: Within the stated complete dataset coverage, a barangay-month with no case line-list records is treated as zero cases rather than a missing report.
limitations: Dataset provenance and completeness are confirmed by the project team based on CHO verification. A separate monthly zero-report register is not included in the application files.
Records without a valid admission date or official barangay remain excluded from barangay-month case counts and are separately reported in the data-quality inventory.
Exact duplicate rows are retained and flagged because no stable case identifier is present.
Some 2018-2019 barangay names do not match the official Iligan list and are excluded from official barangay aggregates pending mapping.
The source does not provide report-received dates or a documented case-definition version.
